correctness.rationale: Explicitly constructed 16-point poset with reflexive transitive antisymmetric order. Equal stratified ordered-atomic-type counts give C2 equivalence via induction; three copies of one pair prevent a join; Cartesian products preserve balanced equitable block partitions and missing joins. Small Boolean posets are uniquely recovered from predecessor/successor counts, with the nontrivial B3 case reduced to the unique 2-regular 3+3 bipartite graph. Finite checker independently checks the base and dimensions four through eight; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A sharp and all-dimensional identification boundary for a canonical family of finite posets in a natural weak logical language; first counterexample is transitive and of the same cardinality, and an explicit product mechanism explains the unbounded family. It separates the order-only reduct from Boolean-algebra operations and addresses a motivated expressive-power question rather than an arbitrary parameter sample.
